definitions.explanation: The money paid or to be paid for goods or services.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}の{代金|だいきん}を{払|はら}う。
examples.english: To pay the price for goods.

examples.japanese: {代金|だいきん}は{後|あと}で{請求|せいきゅう}します。
examples.english: The payment will be billed later.

examples.japanese: {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}で{届|とど}く。
examples.english: It will be delivered cash on delivery.
examples.notes: 代金引換 = cash on delivery (COD)

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代金|だいきん}を{払|はら}う (to pay the price)
- {代金|だいきん}を{受|う}け{取|と}る (to receive payment)
- {代金引換|だいきんひきかえ} (cash on delivery, COD)
- {代金|だいきん}{請求|せいきゅう} (billing, invoice for payment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {代金|だいきん}: Price/payment (for specific goods)
- {値段|ねだん}: Price (general)
- {料金|りょうきん}: Fee, charge (for services)
- {金額|きんがく}: Amount of money
